items.title: Train Conductor Nutcracker
items.alt: Slender conductor nutcracker with a navy cap, cream jacket, green waistcoat and ticket punch.
items.description: A cream jacket opens over a green waistcoat and small watch chain. The conductor holds a blank ticket and metal punch beneath a long face with curled dark sideburns.

items.title: Gardener Nutcracker with Rosemary
items.alt: Gardener nutcracker in a straw-textured hat and sage apron holding a rosemary pot and trowel.
items.description: Rosemary rises from a terracotta pot in one rounded wooden hand. The other holds a trowel beside a pocketed sage apron and ochre lace-up boots.

items.title: Skier Nutcracker
items.alt: Jointed wooden skier nutcracker in a patterned sweater, plum trousers and blue pom-pom cap.
items.description: Bent wooden knees and two separate skis give this nutcracker a gliding pose. A patterned sweater, blue pom-pom hat and long ski poles complete the winter outfit.

items.title: Candy Shop Nutcracker
items.alt: Candy-shop nutcracker with a striped cap, round glasses, mint coat and glass jar of sweets.
items.description: The candy keeper clasps a glass jar filled with wrapped sweets. A striped domed cap, peppermint details, curled pale hair and purple boots create a playful shop display.

items.title: Unpainted Nutcracker with a Chisel
items.alt: Unpainted wooden nutcracker with an exposed rear lever, curled shaving and chisel on a wood block.
items.description: Faceted pale wood remains visible across the toy's cap, beard and angular face. A rear lever projects behind the figure, with a chisel and curled shaving beside its work block.

items.title: Bell-Ringer Nutcracker
items.alt: Nutcracker with an ochre cloak, copper-colored helmet, bronze handbell and purple rope coil.
items.description: An ochre cloak opens around striped breeches and a green jacket. The bell-ringer carries a broad handbell and purple rope beneath a copper-colored domed helmet.
